topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, dynamic beamwidth adjustment, hybrid beamforming, and adaptive power control are essential. These strategies can reduce fluctuations by adjusting beams based on real-time channel conditions, ensuring consistent performance across the band. By integrating these strategies, we can balance the trade-offs between beamwidth and gain, ensuring efficient and consistent performance across the 57-66 GHz band.
